classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Page 44 establishes that [0,1) excludes 1; page 49 identifies an empty intersection as disjoint.

content.prompt:
For each of the following, determine if the sets are disjoint or not disjoint.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=[0,1)\\B&=[1,2)\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked: Every member of $A$ is less than $1$, while every member of $B$ is at least $1$. Hence $A\cap B=\varnothing$.
